WasmOS Lab x86 PC emulator powered by WebAssembly (v86)

1 · Choose a disk

Drop an ISO, floppy or disk image here, or click to browse

2 · Machine

Type any whole number: RAM 16–2048 MB, video 2–256 MB. Very large values may fail if your browser can’t allocate that much memory.

3 · Network

Browsers can’t open raw network connections, so the VM reaches the internet through a relay. Wisp and WebSocket relays need a server you run or trust. Fetch mode needs no server but only carries web traffic that CORS allows. The relay sees the VM’s traffic. Pages served over https need wss:// or wisps:// URLs.

Tips

  • Small OSes work best: KolibriOS, MenuetOS, FreeDOS, Tiny Core, Alpine, Windows 95/98, Linux 2.x–5.x i386 builds.
  • Your files never leave your browser.
  • Click the screen to type; use “Capture mouse” for GUIs.
